# Third-party code

Headers only, copied unchanged so the native tools build without downloading anything.

| Folder | What | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clap/include` | [CLAP](https://github.com/free-audio/clap) plugin API | 1.2.9 | MIT (`clap/LICENSE`) |
| `vst3/pluginterfaces` | [VST3 pluginterfaces](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/vst3_pluginterfaces) (`base` and `vst`) | 3.8.1 build 84 | MIT (`vst3/LICENSE.txt`) |

To update one, replace the folder with the new release's files and change the version here.
